title: Printable bus timetable (example data)
subject: Mathematics
source: Seeded from mathematics/y3 lesson 89 (Printable bus timetable (example data))
intro: Lesson 89: Time word problems. To understand how to solve problems about time, durations and timetables

questions.q: How long does Bus 1 take from the Station to the Park?
Which bus reaches the Masjid at 9:50?
You must be at the Park by 11:00. Which bus do you take?

model.title: Huda reads from 4:15 to 4:40 and then does maths for 25 minutes. When does she finish?

questions.q: Bus 2 leaves the station at 4:35. When does it reach the library?
questions.model: Teacher reads down the Bus 2 column: 4:50.

questions.q: How long from the library to the masjid?
To reach the masjid by 5:15, which bus?
A cake goes in at 2:45 and bakes for 35 minutes. When does it come out? It cools for 20 minutes: when is it ready?
questions.model: Teacher solves the first step with a time line.

questions.q: Asr is at 6:10 pm. Zayd needs 25 minutes to walk and 10 to make wudu. Latest time to start?
A Qur'an class runs 4:30 to 5:15 four days a week. Total time a week?
Big question: what do we look for?
questions.a: The times given, and whether we need a start, an end or a duration.
